description: This file contains functions and types related to building, normalizing, and matching system run approval bindings and environment configurations, including hashing environment entries and comparing approval requests.

methods.name: normalizeSystemRunApprovalFileOperand
methods.description: Normalizes an input value into a SystemRunApprovalFileOperand object or null/undefined if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeSystemRunApprovalPlan
methods.description: Normalizes an input value into a SystemRunApprovalPlan object or null if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeSystemRunEnvEntries
methods.description: Converts environment variables object into a sorted array of key-value pairs after normalization.

methods.name: hashSystemRunEnvEntries
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the environment entries array.

methods.name: buildSystemRunApprovalEnvBinding
methods.description: Builds environment hash and keys from environment variables.

methods.name: buildSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Constructs a SystemRunApprovalBinding object and environment keys array from parameters.

methods.name: argvMatches
methods.description: Checks if two argument arrays match exactly.

methods.name: matchSystemRunApprovalEnvHash
methods.description: Compares expected and actual environment hashes and keys, returning match result.

methods.name: matchSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Compares expected and actual approval bindings and environment keys, returning match result.

methods.name: missingSystemRunApprovalBinding
methods.description: Returns a mismatch result indicating missing environment keys.

methods.name: toSystemRunApprovalMismatchError
methods.description: Converts a mismatch object into an error object with message and details.
